heading: Operation Script Language (JCL)
proposed: A JCL string constant that contains the two characters star and slash (the end-of-comment marker) breaks the generated Java: the operation body is copied into a Java block comment without escaping, so the generated code does not compile. Write such text as two separate string parts, or avoid it in operation scripts.
note: Script2JavaGenerator.xtend:262 copies each statement into '/* ... */' unescaped. Re-check on develop not done.

heading: SDK Query Filters Reference
proposed: The SDK string filter escapes double quotes only. A value that ends in a backslash breaks the quoted filter value, so filters on such values (for example a path such as C:\) return a wrong or failed query. Avoid trailing backslashes in <Entity> filter values, or pass the value through a field that does not need quoting.
note: judo-sdk-common StringFilter.java:76 (getValueAsString). Re-check on develop not done.

heading: Target Datasource Model
proposed: The target datasource model gets no job components and no init-script executor, so init operations and scheduled jobs do not run for it. Put startup seeding and jobs on another model in a multi-model deployment.
note: Catalog list of suppressed components omits jobs and the init-script executor (JobActivator.java:70-76).

heading: Deploying a Model as an OSGi Bundle
proposed: The model bundle deployer's dialects property defaults to empty; the bundle is then looked up as model/<name>-rdbms_.model and nothing loads. Set dialects explicitly (for example postgresql or hsqldb).
note: Default is empty (ModelBundleTracker.java:67) and split gives [""] (ModelBundleTracker.java:89-91). Re-check on develop not done.
